title: Research-only fused SWAP trial-observation contract
question: Can q/status and the E3 execution-class diagnostics be obtained from one physical real-SWAP corrector run, while remaining observationally equivalent to the current separate participant-trial plus raw-diagnostics route?

frozen_matrix.heads: Exactly the unique head offsets required by the G13 streaming path through the confirming scale for each state.

fused_observation_contract: Exactly one backend corrector run is invoked per fused observation.
Return participant-style status and q_swap from that same run.
Return result_status/completed/candidate_ready and all E3 execution-class fields from that same run.
Discard any research candidate before returning; committed revision/time/ledger remain unchanged.
No fused observation is granted commit/publication authority.
regression_gates: For every frozen streaming head, fused participant-style status equals the existing participant trial status.
For every status-0 head, fused q_swap equals the participant q within 1e-18 m/s.
Fused raw result_status/completed/candidate_ready and E3 execution-class fields equal the existing independent raw-diagnostics observation.
Each fused call increments a research-only backend-run counter by exactly one.
Reconstruct E3 streaming from fused observations alone and recover every persisted G13 selected/confirming scale, mode and slope within floating-point tolerance.
Accepted SWAP revision/time/ledger remain unchanged for both FGC44 and MAP09 carriers.
interpretation: PASS qualifies a research integration shape that can attain the G13 fused lower-bound run count without changing E3 semantics on the frozen matrix.
PASS does not authorize a production participant diagnostics accessor or production tangent service.
Any runtime API change requires a separate production-facing design/admission work unit.
